title: SoundPort
body:
Backporting some sounds from modern Minecraft to 1.8.9, because the missing noises for witches and blocks were bothering me.

It creates a resource pack for you to enable. Make sure to delete that when updating so it can generate a new one!


**0.9**:
- Transitioning from alpha to beta!
- Sound logic moved client-side, so we should be working on servers now!
- All sounds besides witch throw and lily pad placement are functional, fix for them Soon:tm:

**0.8.2**:
- Carrots
- Potatoes

**0.8.1**:
- Signs
- Lily Pads
- Item Frame interaction

**0.8**:
- Banners
- Skulls

**0.7.3**:
- Sounds no longer play on unrelated blocks and entities
- Added breaking sounds to entities

**0.7.2**:
- Sounds no longer play on failed placement
- Corrected sound for Iron Door

**0.7.1**:
- Fixed interacting with an empty hand

**0.7**:
- Doors (Iron Doors make wood noises for now)
- Beds
- Armor Stands
- Paintings
- Item Frames
- Seeds

**0.6.7**: 
- Downloading sounds from Mojang's 1.9 assets
- Witches (hit, death, idle, drink, throw)
